intro: Taiwan has about 23 million people, mostly living in big cities on the west coast.

chapters.title: People and languages
text: Most people are of Han Chinese descent; Indigenous peoples make up about 2.5%. Mandarin is the main language, and Taiwanese Hokkien, Hakka and Indigenous languages are also spoken. Traditional Chinese characters are used.
Buddhism, Taoism and folk religion are widely practised.

chapters.title: Life
text: Taiwan was the first place in Asia to legalise same-sex marriage, in 2019. Night markets are a big part of daily life.
